name: advisor
description: Pair Claude Code and Codex CLI through a shared mailbox, or route a one-shot call to Codex. Runs on Codex CLI as the listening side of the pair, or on Claude Code as the asking side — install via `codex plugin add advisor@bootgear`.

interface.shortDescription: Pair with Claude Code through a shared mailbox, or answer a one-shot call.
interface.longDescription: Advisor pairs a Codex CLI session with a Claude Code session through a local file mailbox, or answers a one-shot direct call, for a rewrite, an opinion, an adversarial review, or delegated investigation.
